Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=l.extended_price DESC]
    Project[c.name AS cust_name, o.id AS order_id, l.id AS lineitem_id, l.extended_price AS extended_price, l.discount AS discount]
      Filter[c.nation = 'GERMANY' AND l.discount > 0.05]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=o.id = l.order_id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=c.id = o.cust_id]
            Scan[customer]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[lineitem]
